description: Integration model showing how student notification delivery (notification_candidates) consumes reduced career signals without schema conflict.

integrationFlow.action: source_impact_router ingests verified document -> emits CareerSignalEvent
Event applied to RecruitmentCycle -> updates opportunitySignalActive and processUpdateSignalActive
Queries RecruitmentCycles where (opportunitySignalActive == true OR processUpdateSignalActive == true) matching student target state/category
Creates individual student delivery record nc_${uid}_${cycleId} pointing to the latest event ref. Preserves read/dismissed state.

compatibilityGuarantee: Zero modifications required to existing notification_candidates collection schema. The carrier layer is cleanly decoupled from the state engine.
